overview.description: The Vanguard Morningstar Mega Cap ETF (MGC) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Morningstar US Mega Cap TR USD index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of mega-cap stocks in the US. MGC was launched on Dec 24, 2007 and is issued by Vanguard.
